content.comment_body: Hello, could someone share a concise guide for setting up remote access to the [product_name] web interface for control? I have everything working on the local network and now need to configure remote access.
You need to enable the web server option in the access control settings.
You can use DDNS services like Noip.com and configure port forwarding on your router.

Thanks for replying. I didn’t get a complete answer. I’m looking for detailed steps to access the [product_name] web page remotely. Currently, I control the [product_name] locally via LAN/ethernet using a custom web interface. I need instructions to access this interface remotely from outside the local network, for example, on a mobile device.

From my experience, this approach might have limitations. According to an FAQ from [company_name], custom web pages may not fully load via VPN connections because the web server can respond too slowly.
Thanks for the information. How do others manage remote control of [product_name]?

Hi. I have set up a Raspberry Pi on the local network. Using VNC viewer, I remotely access the Pi, and then use its browser to open [product_name] web pages. Additionally, I have a touchscreen with the Pi for local operation.
Do you have DSL internet connected to your router or network? Or are you using a 4G SIM router?
You can also use Node-Red (requires a server; I use a Raspberry Pi) along with Cayenne or Blynk (both operate via cloud servers).
Yes, the location has DSL internet and the [product_name] is connected to the network via the router.
Try registering for DDNS at Noip.com and configure port forwarding on your router.

analysis.insight_summary: The user is searching for straightforward, step-by-step instructions for configuring remote access to the [product_name] web interface, having achieved local network control. Community responses suggest network configuration techniques and using third-party solutions, but also highlight reliability issues such as slow web server response over VPN and lack of direct support from [company_name]. Alternate solutions include remote control via Raspberry Pi and cloud platforms, indicating practical difficulties and workarounds for remotely accessing [product_name] web pages.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects a clear step-by-step guide to enable remote or mobile access to the [product_name] web interface, replicating the local network setup’s success.
